item.title: All flights to and from Srinagar cancelled due to snowfall, tourists stranded
item.description: Srinagar: All flights to and from Srinagar International Airport were cancelled on Tuesday due to snowfall in Kashmir, officials said. “Due to adverse weather conditions and continuous snowfall in Srinagar, the runway is currently not available for safe aircraft operations. In the interest of passenger safety, all flight operations to and from Srinagar have been cancelled for the day,” an Airport Authority of India official said here. item.title: J-K speaker convenes all-party meeting ahead of Budget Session on Feb 2
item.description: Jammu: An all-parties meeting will be convened ahead of the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly’s Budget Session, scheduled to begin next month, Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather said on Tuesday, urging legislators to make effective use of the proceedings by raising public issues for redressal. item.title: CRPF jawan among four dead in road crash in JK’s Udhampur
item.description: Jammu, Jan 27 (PTI) Four people, including a CRPF jawan, were killed and a woman injured when a bus hit a parked load carrier and a motorcycle in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur district on Tuesday, officials said. The accident occurred near Jakhani-Chenani area on Jammu-Srinagar national highway around 11 am. item.title: Flights Resume as Snow Cleared at Srinagar Airport
item.description: Srinagar, Jan 28: Flight operations at Srinagar International Airport resumed on Wednesday, a day after heavy snowfall forced the cancellation of all services, officials said. The first flight landed at 9:25 am, and authorities expect normal operations to continue throughout the day if weather conditions remain stable. “The runway, taxiway, and apron have been cleared of snow and are ready for use,” the Airport Authority of India (AAI) said in a statement. item.title: 28-Year-Old man dies of Suffocation inside Vehicle in South Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 28: A 28-year-old man died of suffocation inside his Tata Mobile load carrier at District Hospital Kulgam in south Kashmir on Wednesday morning, officials said. An official said that the deceased has been identified as Mashooq Ahmad Mir, son of Mohammad Yousuf Mir, a resident of Koulpora, Kulgam. item.title: Disaster-prone areas on twin routes to be marked ahead of Amarnath Yatra in J-K
item.description: Jammu, Jan 29: Disaster-prone and vulnerable areas along the twin routes leading to the Amarnath shrine in south Kashmir Himalayas will be marked ahead of the yatra to the shrine in south Kashmir Himalayas, officials said on Thursday. item.title: Jammu gears up for YSS-JKSC football, cricket premier leagues next month
item.description: Jammu, Jan 29 : Jammu will host the YSS-JKSC Football and Cricket Premier Leagues in a bid to strengthen grassroots sports, with matches scheduled to begin early next month, an official said on Thursday. item.title: Mobile services suspended in 3 areas of Kishtwar till January 30
item.description: Jammu,Jan 30: The Jammu and Kashmir Home Department has ordered the temporary suspension of mobile data services, including 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G, in select areas of Kishtwar district as a precautionary security measure. According to the official order, mobile internet services have been suspended in Singhpora, Chingam and Chatroo areas of Kishtwar from 12:01 am on January 29, 2026, till 11:59 pm on January 30, 2026, to prevent possible misuse by anti-national elements. item.title: Two held for impersonating as JMC Officials in Jammu
item.description: Jammu, Jan 30 : Two persons were arrested for allegedly impersonating officials of the Jammu Municipal Corporation (JMC) and cheating citizens here, police said on Friday.
